title: Descent of Basic Forms to Quotients by Locally Free Lie Group Actions
summary: We prove an equivariant version of the theorem of Hector, Macías-Virgós, and Sanmartín-Carbón identifying diffeological forms on the leaf space of a foliation with basic forms. For any group $K$ acting by foliation-preserving diffeomorphisms, we show that this identification is an isomorphism of $K$-equivariant cochain complexes. We then establish a descent theorem for basic differential forms under locally free Lie group actions without assuming properness.
